title: Ending a SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program
content:
# Program Terms: Written Notice, Closure and Early Termination

## 1. The customer's own act

Ending the program is the customer's own act by written notice. An active or suspended SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program is ended by the customer's written notice; a customer may also cancel a program that is enrolled but not yet live, before go-live.

## 2. Closure date

The program closes no earlier than the tier's termination notice period in calendar days after the date the written termination notice is received. Count calendar days starting the day after the notice is received; the program closes on the last day of the notice period or a later date the notice names.

- **Clock start:** the date the written termination notice is received, as recorded on the company's own program record.
- **Counting:** the day after receipt is day 1, in calendar days.
- **Comparison:** the closure date is not earlier than the last day of the notice period; that last day itself is allowed.
- **Closure date:** the last day of the notice period, or a later date the notice names.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, on a tier with a 30-day notice period)

| Closure date | Counted day | Allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| The 29th calendar day after receipt of the notice | Day 29 | No — earlier than the notice period allows |
| The 30th calendar day after receipt | Day 30, the last day of the notice period | Yes |
| A later date named in the notice, the 45th calendar day after receipt | Day 45 | Yes, the program closes on the named date |

## 3. What happens on closure

On closure all unused allowance expires, redemptions already made are billed, and the tier's early termination fee applies once when closure falls before the tier's minimum term in months after go-live.

Example (hypothetical): a program on a tier with a 12-month minimum term closes 9 months after go-live. Its unused allowance expires on closure, the redemptions already made are billed, and the early termination fee is charged once.
